fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 47% match is a Weak Fit for this Elasticsearch search-algorithms role.

**Strengths:**
- Java plus Kotlin and Spring Boot, designing and running the settlement service
- PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka: moved hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis
- Led 4 engineers through a 9 month monolith-to-6-services migration

**Gaps:**
- No search or vector database experience (Elasticsearch, Solr, HNSW, IVF)
- No evidence of Java concurrency constructs or lambdas
- No MongoDB or Cassandra; no AI-assisted development evidence

**Recommendation:** Build a small Java project using Elasticsearch or Lucene with vector search, contribute upstream, then apply with that work as proof.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Elastic

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Search Relevance team needs engineers who can take a hard problem in a fast-moving codebase and own it from design to delivery. At Lumen Payments, the payment status API was too slow, so I moved hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis and cut p99 latency from 480 ms to 120 ms. Finding where a data store is the bottleneck and fixing it is work I know well.

I'm a Senior Backend Engineer with 11 years of experience building payment and event-processing services in Java, Kotlin and Python. I haven't worked on search or vector databases, so I won't claim that; what I bring is strong Java, a solid grasp of how PostgreSQL, Redis and Kafka behave under load, and a habit of careful API design and code review. I also led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, which meant guiding a project from technical design to delivery. During a recent career break I kept learning, and I contributed small bug fixes to an open-source Kotlin library, so the pull request workflow you describe is familiar. I'm ready to apply that same approach to Elasticsearch and Lucene, and to your globally distributed team's way of working.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I can contribute to your vector search work. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer - Search Algorithms
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Elastic Hiring Team,

I've spent 11 years building Java and Kotlin backend services, most recently leading a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, so I know how to guide technical work from design to delivery. I bring strong Core Java, PostgreSQL and data storage fundamentals, along with a habit of careful code review and clear, readable code. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm returning to full-time engineering and can start in four weeks, and I'm free for a call any weekday this week or next.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

Kind regards,
Priya Raman
